case_data.title: Odyssean Process (on AI)
case_data.provide-a-brief-description-of-the-proje:
The Odyssean Process is a methodology developed in 2023 designed to integrate expert elicitation with exploratory modelling and scenario planning, culminating in a citizens’ assembly. The framework aims to address simultaneous systems failures across media, science, the economy, and politics—particularly regarding the management of systemic risks and the integration of science with public reason in the face of accumulating tipping points in Earth and social systems.

The inaugural full application of this process is being delivered in Britain to assist with the global, long-term governance of AI.
- **May 2026:** Conclusion of the initial expert phases.
- **June 2026:** Release of interim findings and initial modelling. These outputs will support a presentation in Geneva demonstrating how innovation and existing best practice intersect for complex, long-term policy problems in AI.
- **July 2026:** Commencement of the Citizens' Assembly.
- **September – November 2026:** Intense deliberative phase of the assembly.
- **December 2026 – Q2 2027:** Publication of a comprehensive policy report, peer-reviewed papers, and a accompanying documentary.
case_data.what-limitations-to-the-project-should-b: Funding and availability of ideal expertise in oversight and advice, although our network has been considerably helpful to maintain a high quality for such an ambitious pilot
case_data.additional-acknowledgements: Jacob Haimes, James Balzer, Renske van Vroonhoven, Jonathan Salter, Matthew Ball
case_data.inclusion-efforts: We utilised the Sortition Foundation who had previously used 30,000 randomly selected addresses for postal invites. Due to time and budget constraints, our approach used a list of those who responded to prior communications of this randomised kind, but were unable to participate initially.

project-goals: Methods: Create re-usable participation tools & methods
Quantitative: Generate statistical evidence on public attitudes to AI
Qualitative: Capture qualitative evidence on public attitudes to AI
Empowerment: Build community power with respect to AI
case_data.describe-the-subject-matter-in-your-own-: How to understand and govern AI for ourselves, the world, and future generations
